reviewText: Decades a petsitter. Searching for soft litter for a feline with inflamed pads (pillow paw). Course to the touch, I sprayed with water - huge mistake! There's a powder glue that made it crust over (for clumping). After scraping off the crust, she used it. As long as waste is covered, there's no smell (even to my hyper sensitive nose). But I've always scooped boxes daily, 2x a day. What I've found is no litter box is large enough to go an entire day without scooping - even for 6 lbs cats. Worst part about this litter: the urine seeps to the bottom immediately - impossible to detect without scooping entire box… which in my case it had glued to the box… so maybe some kind of liner is needed. Ordered another that claims to be the softest, and more boxes to see which she prefers. For now, gone back to pre-moisten pellets, tho, there's plenty of this brand left, it'll wait until the extra boxes arrive. Always purchase unsented, your pets have far more sensitive noses than you.
itemName: Catalyst Pet Softwood Natural Clumping Cat Litter Unscented Formula, 34 lb

reviewText: I can't recommend this litter. It is extremely dusty. Every time my black cat comes out of the litter box he's an entirely different color because he's covered in the dust from it. I have to wipe his face and paws every time because flakes will stay caked on him, even though he's totally dry and not usually messy in the litter box. The smell is also very strong, which some may not mind but I try to have scentless where possible. Anytime I added more of this litter I would be sneezing for an hour after. It's very light, but that also makes it very hard to sift through when scooping. It doesn't want to fall through the scoop unless you shake a lot. I still have half the bag left and will be throwing it away as soon as the other litter I ordered get here.

reviewText:
my old cat still goes outside, so was not affected by use of this new litter.  it likely reminds him of loose forested ground.  I had mixed it with existing lightweight clay. It actually appears to be faster at clumping and eliminating odors!  I love the light weight of it, and although he tracks it some it isn't gritty like clay.  The  bag itself, at 28 lbs is a bit awkward to pour in the initial stages but I bought because of the much better value per pound than clay.  My old cat has some health issues and uses the litterbox many times per day. 
Can't give 5 stars yet cos I haven't gotten the box diluted down to 0-2% clay, though I expect continued excellence.
